notes: Workflow: only scan 002, its two witnesses, C alerts, the supplied preamble, notation snapshot, brief and crop script were read. The whole image was opened once for layout; half_a then half_b were each opened once. Every continuous text line and each mathematical occurrence was compared against both witnesses, including their agreements. Only listed unsettled marks and small mathematical details were enlarged in 21 tight crops. No OCR, text-recognition software, PDF text layer, web research or another reader’s output was used.

The half views already settled the baseline x in CxC and the straight typewriter quotation marks. Those H differences are explicitly flagged as half-settled in changes; the main reader still needs personal adjudication crops for them. No settled whole or half was reopened, and no crop was recropped.

The page is a typescript with interlinear, marginal and in-line pen additions, typewriter overprints and pen cancellations. Hands are conservatively labelled unnamed. The upper-right delivery inscription appears visually distinct in size/ductus from the large corrective writing; no person is attributed from this page alone.

The top-centre page number is 1. The lower-left pencil 1 is recorded only as an archive sheet number comment. The upper-right note reads 9/74, Envoyé par Grothendieck. No six-page total is written on this sheet; H’s six-page description is editorial information and was not imported into the reading.

The title is Esquisse d’une théorie des Gr-Catégories, by par Mme Hoang Xuan Sinh. The underlying cedilla-bearing character in Esquisse remains visible under the live i. The introduction says that the author gives a résumé of results forming a detailed work intended as a doctoral thesis; the reference brackets are blank.

Section 1 introduces categories with a binary tensor operation, associative and unital up to given isomorphism with compatibility conditions referred to Saavedra. The hand adds the groupoid condition and then the text states invertibility of each object. These are statements transcribed from the page, not theorems checked in this reading.

The first example uses loops in a pointed topological space and homotopy classes of homotopies. The first occurrence is singular d’homotopie followed by plural d’homotopies; both were verified rather than regularized. A variant concerns an associative Hopf space, or a sufficiently strongly homotopy-associative one. The marginal note links the loop example to that variant and contains Ω with a raised 1.

The left edge physically clips several marginal beginnings and any possible sign before Ω. Their completions remain marked; contextual plausibility is not presented as surviving ink. The recurrent typed variable is visually a composite/overstruck glyph; G is preferred without assuming that the heavy impression mandates a blackboard or bold alphabet.

After the NB sentence, the remaining closure .) is live and the following cursive continuation is crossed. At least qui and lui can be read with moderate confidence. The circumflex and letter bodies support a tentative même; the final approximate two word groups remain physically unreadable. This is handwritten, not the typed line described in H’s note.

Example 2 states that torsors under a sheaf F, with Baer composition, form a (Gr)-category and even a strict Picard category; it then mentions invertible Modules on a locally ringed space or topos and F equal to the starred underlined structure symbol. The source says un faisceau without an added commutativity qualification here; no mathematical repair was introduced.

Example 3 uses the full subcategory of equivalences in the underlined Hom expression. The handwritten is qualifier and C insertion are retained. It then broadens A to an object of an arbitrary 2-category and begins a sheaf-of-groups example that continues beyond this page. No following scan was consulted.

There are no free-standing mathematical displays or mathematical diagrams on this page. The one non-textual reference arrow in the left margin is represented with TikZ inside the marginal note. Underlines, overwritten letters, crossed example labels, original/corrected numbering and final parenthesis/X placement are retained.

The page’s mathematical expressions prompted visual inspection of the inverse exponent, both relations, unit subscripts, five overstruck space glyphs, Ω exponent, underlined O and Hom symbols, star and is qualifier. Those are transcription/structure observations only. No targeted proof check, independent re-proof, computation or formal certificate was performed.
